title: Confetti Cannon
description: A button that fires confetti out of both corners of its stage. You already pressed it twice.
usage: For the moments software should celebrate out loud: the deploy, the signup, the invoice marked paid. Two cannons fire from the stage corners in the token palette — even the confetti is on-token. It fires once when it scrolls into view, then waits for the button like a loaded party.
a11y: The celebration is visual only: the success it marks must be announced in words by the thing it celebrates ("Payment complete" — the Result part exists for exactly this). Under prefers-reduced-motion the cannon stays unloaded and the button simply says its line.
